description: This is a JavaScript source file defining a React-like component 'Home' using the Lightning.js framework, responsible for rendering the main weather dashboard page with UI elements such as top bar, side navigation, weather cards, forecast strip, and managing state including fetching weather data.

methods.name: updateClock
methods.description: Updates the clock display by setting the current time in 'timeText' state.

methods.name: buildDisplays
methods.description: Builds the display data for weather, forecast, and UI elements based on current state.

methods.name: formatDateLabel
methods.description: Formats a date string into a label like 'Today', 'Tomorrow', or weekday name.

methods.name: iconPathFor
methods.description: Returns the file path for a weather icon given its key.

methods.name: safeVal
methods.description: Returns a formatted string for a numeric value with a suffix, or '--' if invalid.

methods.name: formatUpdated
methods.description: Formats an ISO string into a local time string indicating last update time.

methods.name: refreshData
methods.description: Fetches current weather and forecast data asynchronously and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: onTopAction
methods.description: Handles actions triggered from the top bar, like refresh or toggle units.

methods.name: onNavSelect
methods.description: Handles navigation selection, updates current route.

methods.name: onSideNavNavigate
methods.description: Handles navigation directory commands like move right or down.

methods.name: onForecastSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a forecast item.

methods.name: applyFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the current focus area component.

methods.name: focusNav
methods.description: Sets focus to the navigation component.

methods.name: focusCard
methods.description: Sets focus to the weather card component.

methods.name: focusStrip
methods.description: Sets focus to the forecast strip component.
